name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Account Executive / Go-to-Market | Technical B2B Sales, AI Agent Demos & GTM Strategy
summary: Technical B2B sales professional who also builds the product he'd be demoing. Deep AI/agentic fluency; voice-specific experience is new ground, worth saying directly.
